subject: Germany
note: Cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary). The map shows present-day Germany only; the former border is not drawn. A timeline strip carries the three dates.

claims.text: After World War II Germany was occupied and divided by the four Allied countries. West Germany was formed on 23 May 1949 and the Soviet-occupied zone formed East Germany in October 1949.
The turning point, called Die Wende, was marked by the fall of the Berlin Wall on the night of 9 November 1989.

Reunification culminated on 3 October 1990 with the dissolution of the German Democratic Republic and the integration of its federated states into the Federal Republic of Germany, forming present-day Germany.
The reunited state is not a successor state, but an enlarged continuation of the 1949–1990 West German state.
